description.value: Slo Coffee is a specialty coffee shop that originated in Vancouver's Fraserhood neighbourhood and expanded to a second downtown location at Pacific Centre in December 2025. The shop is built around a philosophy of mindful, unhurried coffee culture—emphasizing community, connection, and quality pour-overs and espresso drinks. Food offerings include vegan-friendly spreads, toasts, and overnight oats alongside sandwiches and seasonal signature beverages.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 47m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (4 spaces) at 94m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record covers the 609 Granville St (Pacific Centre/Downtown) location, confirmed by the website listing that same address as one of two Slo Coffee locations; a December 2025 blog post further confirms this is a newly opened downtown branch. The website references 'vegan spreads, toasts and overnight oats' available on the menu, providing explicit evidence of vegan options. No bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM had no phone number; phone (604) 260-6329 sourced from website only.

Website's homepage description ('heart of the Fraserhood Community') refers to the original Fraser Street location, not this 609 Granville St (Pacific Centre) branch — potential confusion for visitors.

The downtown location opened December 2025; OSM opening hours differ slightly from the hours listed on the website for the Pacific Centre location (e.g., Saturday start time discrepancy), suggesting OSM data may need updating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible cafe with a confirmed physical downtown Vancouver location that opened December 2025.
enrichment_extras.notes: Slo Coffee operates two locations: the original at 4160 Fraser Street (V5V 4E8) and this newer downtown/Pacific Centre branch at 609 Granville St (V7Y 1H2). Each location should have its own directory entry.
